content: stripe-python: responses are StripeObject instances. Through v14 StripeObject inherited from dict, giving both attribute and item access; v7.1.0 added precise inline type annotations and nested-object subclasses. RFC #1454 documents that dict inheritance caused hard collisions (subscription.items returned dict.items method, plus keys/values/get), and v15 REMOVED dict inheritance entirely, replacing it with attribute access + bracket notation + to_dict()/as_dict(). Stripe does not validate responses: unknown/missing fields are tolerated silently; drift is managed via API-version pinning, not client-side validation.
